title: 第八章 天家事
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

昨夜，秦勉以叶三娘要上户为由，问柳妈要来金家的户帖。

她阅后确认，金家属于本朝“民户”底下的“商户”，作坊中的工匠，即使不住在金家，也都挂名于本户，由户主管束、向街坊的里长报告。

一个叫李顺，一个叫彭山。

此际，秦勉在门边轻咳一声，专注干活的几人发现东家来了，纷纷起身行礼。

其中容长脸、眉眼灵活的四旬汉子，殷勤道：“昨天听柳妈讲，大小姐病好了，大善，大善！”

他身后年轻几岁的男子，则面相憨厚些，也无甚讨好东家的开场白，而是直接说货品的事。

“大小姐，这几日我与老李把行会退回来的珍珠都查验了，哪里是我们的珠子不佳，分明是被人泡水太久，才皱了皮。”

秦勉将李、彭两位师傅的姓名与脸对上号，点头道：“我和柳妈都明白，是碰上了蛮横不讲理的富家女眷，行首又不肯为咱们说句公道话。算了。”

李顺很善察言观色，一听东家这样讲，忙顺竿子拍马屁：“大小姐真是宰相气量。幸好咱们赶工出来的换货，及时送上贵客的船，只是苦了您奔波来去、累出一场大病。”

又话锋一转，从案头捡出三四样半成品：“我与小彭做了几个新花样儿，请大小姐过目。”

秦勉上辈子历练出的眼力，今日终于也有了用武之地，不至于露了“隔行如隔山”的怯。

她接过一枚累丝嵌珠的耳璫，赞道：“只用湖珠，到底素了些，你们用玛瑙算盘珠坠成流苏，达官贵人、豪商巨贾的女眷会更喜欢。”

李师傅眯眼笑道：“可不，我媳妇说，她每次给咱送午饭，就在路上瞧那些有钱人家的奶奶小姐。眼见着这几年，她们的裙衫，越来越艳，太平年岁嘛，合该如此。首饰也得颜色鲜一些，才配得起她们。”

李顺关于女子能出门的事，所言不虚。

大琉之前的大晟朝，胡族统治再酷烈，于妇人的起居上，倒不似中原礼教那般严苛。

江山又回到汉人手里后，朝堂致力于收复疆土、扩充田地和增加人口，还没空在百姓风化上花心思，所以，女子们便仍保留着几分出行的自在。

这正给了秦勉及时出门的机会。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Last night, Qin Mian used the excuse that Ye Sanniang wanted to go to the household and asked Liu Ma for the Jin family's household registration card.

After reading it, she confirmed that the Jin family was a "merchant household" under the "civilian household" of the dynasty. Even if the craftsmen in the workshop did not live in the Jin family, they were all registered under the name of the household. They were controlled by the head of the household and reported to the neighborhood chief.

One is named Li Shun and the other is named Pengshan.

At this moment, Qin Mian coughed lightly at the door. Several people who were concentrating on their work noticed that their boss was coming, and they all stood up and saluted.

Among them, a man in his forties with a long face and lively eyebrows said enthusiastically: "I heard from Mother Liu yesterday that the eldest lady has recovered from her illness, which is a great kindness, a great kindness!"

The man behind him, who was a few years younger, had a more honest face. He didn't make any opening remarks to please his boss, but directly talked about the goods.

"Miss, Lao Li and I have inspected all the pearls returned by the guild in the past few days. Our pearls are not good at all. They are obviously wrinkled because they have been soaked in water for too long."

Qin Mian matched the names and faces of the two masters Li and Peng, nodded and said: "Both Mother Liu and I understand that we have encountered an overbearing and unreasonable rich woman, and the leader of the line is unwilling to say a fair word for us. Forget it."

Li Shun was very observant. When his boss said this, he hurriedly flattered her: "Miss, you are really a prime minister. Fortunately, we rushed out the replacement and sent it to the distinguished guest's ship in time. It just made you suffer from traveling back and forth and made you seriously ill."

The topic changed again, and he picked out three or four semi-finished products from the desk: "Xiao Peng and I made some new tricks, please take a look at them."

Qin Mian's vision, which he had developed in his previous life, was finally put to use today, so that he would not show his timidity of "walking across a line like a mountain".

She took over an earring with silk beads and praised it: "Only lake beads are used to make it more plain. If you use agate abacus beads to make tassels, the women of dignitaries and wealthy businessmen will like it more."

Master Li narrowed his eyes and smiled and said, "No, my wife said that every time she delivers lunch to us, she looks at the grandmothers and ladies from wealthy families on the road. In the past few years, their dresses have become more and more colorful. It should be like this in peaceful years. The jewelry must also be in brighter colors to match them."

What Li Shun said about women being able to go out was true.

In the Dasheng Dynasty before Da Liu, no matter how cruel the rule of the Hu people was, women's daily life was not as strict as the Central Plains ethics.

After the country returned to the hands of the Han people, the court devoted itself to regaining territory, expanding fields, and increasing the population. It had no time to spend time on the customs of the people, so the women still retained some freedom of travel.

This gave Qin Mian the opportunity to go out in time.
